summary: Petrobras filed a routine Form 6-K reporting receipt of two diesel Economic Subvention Program installments: R$643.8 million for June 1-15 sales under Provisional Measure No. 1,358 and R$1,923.7 million for June 16-30 sales under Provisional Measure No. 1,363. Cumulative receipts across diesel, gasoline and LPG subsidy programs total roughly R$9.5 billion. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or transaction mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary government-subsidy cash receipt disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for timing and recognition of future installments.
